csv_project_name: Design for SR 54 Suncoast Pkwy Road Widening
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Florida ,Department of Transportation, may be seeking a Consultant for Design for Widen Suncoast Pkwy (SR 589), N of Lutz Lake to SR 54. Project consists of widening the Suncoast Parkway to provide eight (8) lanes, (four [4] tolled lanes in each direction) along the mainline, beginning just north of the Lutz Lake Fern Road bridge and ending at SR 54 bridge. Widening of the southbound exit ramp at SR 54 is included under FPID 456151-1; however, this project 442665-2/3 may include related work in adjacent areas (e.g., utilities, drainage, signals, pedestrian features, and tie-ins) as necessary to support the overall improvements.
